<documents>
<document id="card-fraud-lock">
WhyˆisˆmyˆcardˆlockedˆbyˆTallowbrook?ˆIfˆtheˆappˆsaysˆyourˆcardˆisˆ"LockedˆbyˆTallowbrook",ˆourˆfraudˆsystemsˆhaveˆplacedˆaˆfraudˆlockˆonˆit.ˆThisˆisˆdifferentˆfromˆaˆfreezeˆyouˆsetˆyourself.ˆ##ˆWhyˆitˆhappensˆWeˆlockˆaˆcardˆwhenˆweˆseeˆactivityˆthatˆlooksˆlikeˆfraud,ˆorˆwhenˆaˆfraudˆalertˆgoesˆunansweredˆforˆ24ˆhours.ˆ##ˆHowˆtoˆgetˆitˆremovedˆ-ˆIfˆthere'sˆanˆopenˆfraudˆalertˆinˆtheˆapp,ˆanswerˆit.ˆTappingˆ"Yes,ˆthatˆwasˆme"ˆusuallyˆremovesˆtheˆlockˆstraightˆaway.ˆ-ˆIfˆthere'sˆnoˆalert,ˆmessageˆusˆinˆtheˆapp.ˆSupportˆwillˆpassˆyourˆcaseˆtoˆtheˆFraudˆteam.ˆSupportˆcan'tˆremoveˆaˆfraudˆlock,ˆandˆneitherˆcanˆtheˆfreezeˆswitch.ˆTheˆFraudˆteamˆrepliesˆwithinˆ2ˆbusinessˆdays,ˆoftenˆmuchˆsooner.ˆ##ˆMeanwhileˆDepositsˆandˆincomingˆtransfersˆstillˆarriveˆwhileˆyourˆcardˆisˆlocked.ˆYouˆcanˆalsoˆstillˆuseˆBrookPayˆandˆtransfers,ˆunlessˆtheˆFraudˆteamˆhasˆrestrictedˆthoseˆtoo.ˆWeˆwillˆneverˆaskˆyouˆtoˆconfirmˆaˆfraudˆalertˆbyˆgivingˆusˆyourˆfullˆcardˆnumber,ˆPINˆorˆaˆone-timeˆcode.ˆNeedˆmoreˆhelp?ˆMessageˆusˆinˆtheˆappˆanyˆtime,ˆdayˆorˆnight.
</document>
<document id="security-fraud-alerts">
HowˆfraudˆalertsˆworkˆWhenˆweˆseeˆaˆcardˆtransactionˆthatˆlooksˆunusual,ˆweˆdeclineˆitˆandˆsendˆyouˆaˆfraudˆalertˆinˆtheˆapp,ˆandˆbyˆtextˆifˆyou'veˆturnedˆthatˆon.ˆ##ˆAnsweringˆanˆalertˆTheˆalertˆshowsˆtheˆmerchant,ˆamountˆandˆlocation.ˆTapˆ"Yes,ˆthatˆwasˆme"ˆorˆ"No,ˆthatˆwasn'tˆme".ˆ-ˆ**Yes:**ˆtheˆcardˆisˆunlockedˆstraightˆaway.ˆTryˆtheˆpurchaseˆagain.ˆ-ˆ**No:**ˆtheˆcardˆstaysˆlocked.ˆWe'llˆguideˆyouˆthroughˆreportingˆitˆandˆdisputingˆanyˆotherˆcharges.ˆ##ˆIfˆyouˆdon'tˆanswerˆIfˆyouˆdon'tˆanswerˆwithinˆ24ˆhours,ˆtheˆcardˆstaysˆlockedˆuntilˆyouˆcontactˆus.ˆ##ˆIsˆthisˆalertˆreal?ˆRealˆalertsˆappearˆinsideˆtheˆTallowbrookˆapp.ˆAˆtextˆalertˆonlyˆeverˆasksˆyouˆtoˆreplyˆYESˆorˆNO,ˆandˆneverˆcontainsˆaˆlink.ˆWeˆneverˆaskˆforˆyourˆcardˆnumber,ˆPIN,ˆpasswordˆorˆaˆone-timeˆcodeˆtoˆconfirmˆanˆalert.ˆIfˆsomeoneˆcallsˆyouˆaboutˆaˆfraudˆalert,ˆhangˆupˆandˆopenˆtheˆappˆinstead.ˆ##ˆTooˆmanyˆalerts?ˆAlertsˆareˆmoreˆcommonˆwhenˆyouˆshopˆsomewhereˆnewˆorˆabroad.ˆTheyˆgetˆlessˆfrequentˆasˆourˆsystemsˆlearnˆyourˆpatterns.ˆQuestions?ˆOurˆsupportˆteamˆisˆavailableˆinˆtheˆappˆatˆanyˆhour.
</document>
<document id="travel-notice-v2">
DoˆIˆneedˆaˆtravelˆnotice?ˆNo.ˆYouˆdon'tˆneedˆtoˆtellˆusˆbeforeˆyouˆtravel.ˆWeˆretiredˆtravelˆnoticesˆandˆtheˆTravelˆmodeˆsetting,ˆandˆourˆfraudˆchecksˆnowˆuseˆyourˆlocationˆandˆspendingˆpatternsˆinstead.ˆ##ˆWhatˆtoˆdoˆinsteadˆ-ˆKeepˆappˆnotificationsˆon.ˆIfˆweˆseeˆanˆunusualˆpurchase,ˆwe'llˆsendˆaˆfraudˆalertˆthatˆyouˆcanˆconfirmˆwithˆoneˆtap.ˆ-ˆAnswerˆfraudˆalertsˆquickly.ˆIfˆanˆalertˆgoesˆunansweredˆforˆ24ˆhours,ˆtheˆcardˆstaysˆlockedˆuntilˆyouˆcontactˆus.ˆ-ˆCheckˆthatˆInternationalˆpurchasesˆisˆswitchedˆonˆunderˆCards,ˆthenˆControls.ˆ##ˆOldˆtravelˆnoticesˆIfˆyouˆsetˆaˆtravelˆnoticeˆbeforeˆweˆretiredˆtheˆfeature,ˆthere'sˆnothingˆyouˆneedˆtoˆdo.ˆOldˆnoticesˆwereˆdeletedˆandˆdon'tˆaffectˆyourˆcard.ˆ##ˆStillˆworried?ˆAddingˆaˆvirtualˆcardˆtoˆyourˆphone'sˆwalletˆbeforeˆyouˆleaveˆgivesˆyouˆaˆbackupˆifˆyourˆphysicalˆcardˆisˆlostˆorˆdeclined.ˆNeedˆmoreˆhelp?ˆMessageˆusˆinˆtheˆappˆanyˆtime,ˆdayˆorˆnight.
</document>
</documents>

Customer question: What happens if I don't respond to a fraud alert?

response.text: {"answer":"If you don’t respond to a fraud alert within 24 hours, your card stays locked until you contact Tallowbrook.
